title: 风雨夜

series.next: A message from 何小姐: 来吧。最后一次。

setting: Your flat in 深圳, your twenty-first birthday, midnight. A typhoon over the city. 小柏 is away.

stranger.name: 老马
stranger.en: older, tanned, in a good coat soaked through

steps.narr: Your twenty-first birthday. A typhoon over 深圳. Rain like gravel on the windows. Midnight.
On your shelf: 舅舅's photo, in a frame from the night market.

else.narr: Your shelf is bare. Books, and nothing from home.

steps.narr: At the door: a man in his fifties, tanned dark, a good coat soaked through. He looks at you as if he's waited years for this.

say.en: Ask him, politely: and you are...?
say.tip: 您是……？ = and you are...? Leave it hanging: they fill in the rest.

ok.en: The name's 马. Call me 老马.
It's pouring. Let me in for a minute?

4.gloss: At this hour... excuse me, you are?

steps.narr: He sits on the edge of a chair, dripping. When he crosses his legs, you see it: round one ankle, an old scar, the width of a chain.
He picks up 舅舅's photo from the shelf, and holds it a long time.

else.narr: His eyes go to your bare shelf, and stay there. You notice him noticing.

say.en: Recognise him: it's you, the man from the mudflats.
say.gloss: It's you... the man on the mudflats.
say.tip: 泥滩 nítān = mudflats: 泥 mud, 滩 a shore.

fail.en: That year, on the mudflats. Don't you remember?

answers: 是你……那年在泥滩上的人。
4.gloss: It's you... the man on the mudflats, that year.

steps.zh: 这些年，我在外国跑船。挣了钱。
steps.en: All these years I've worked the ships, abroad. I made money.
The money for your studies, for this flat...

steps.narr: Not 何小姐. It was never 何小姐.

steps.en: That day, you gave me the pliers.

else.en: That day, you gave me food.

steps.en: I told you I'd remember you.

ok.en: That day, the whole world was hunting me.

ok.zh: 我想让你，过另一种生活。
ok.en: I wanted you to have a different life.

answers: 那么多人，为什么偏偏是我？
4.gloss: Of all the people in the world, why me?
4.tip: 偏偏 piānpiān = of all things, out of everyone.

steps.zh: 可是那件旧案子，还没完。
steps.en: But that old case isn't closed.

steps.zh: 要是在这儿有人认出我……

say.en: Hide him here for now, or send him away, for his own safety.
say.tip: 先 xiān = first, for now: 您先住这儿 = stay here for the time being.

ok.narr: He falls asleep in the armchair in his wet coat, like a man who hasn't slept in years.

alts.en: Or: send him away, for his safety
alts.gloss: Go, quickly. It isn't safe here.

then.zh: 我走。可是，我还会来看你。
then.en: I'll go. But I'll come and see you again.

then.narr: He goes back out into the rain. He doesn't take an umbrella.

answers: 外面雨大，您先住这儿吧。
4.gloss: It's pouring out there. Stay here for now.

answers: 您快走吧，这里不安全，保重。
alts.gloss: Go, quickly. It isn't safe here. Take care of yourself.

steps.en: Dawn. The typhoon has passed. In your armchair, the man who paid for everything, snoring. ⛈️

else.en: Dawn. The typhoon has passed. On the table, a wet envelope with a phone number in it, and nothing else. ⛈️
